thread:
marco (growth): Quick plan: 5-day midweek burst for the product launch webinar. We want signups + SQLs. Aim: CPL < $35, SQL conversion > 12%.

rachel (paid-search): I'm ready to push. Proposed: +40% non-branded search budget into retarget audiences, enable short bid bursts during commute hours. Also testing a 3:1 spend split vid:static on retarget.

dee (content): I'll produce two new creative packages: 15s vertical video (demo highlight) and a carousel of three pain-point slides. Messaging hooks: "Reduce inference costs" and "Ship faster" — keeping versioning consistent with landing H1.

sam (analytics): Note: GA4 attribution window currently 30d; for webinar let's use 7d last-click for rapid signals. Server-side events will include utm_content and creative_id. I'll surface cohort-level CPL + SQL rate.

tina (ops): Routing: leadbot webhook is ready at `https://api.rwd.internal/hooks/webinar-midweek`. Payload includes: email, utm_source, utm_campaign, creative_id. SFDC flow: if utm_campaign contains "midweek-launch" set lead owner to PLG-sales queue.

leadbot: Test event delivered: status=200 OK, sample payload: `{email: "test@example.com", utm_campaign: "midweek-launch-1", creative_id: "vid_15s_01"}`

rachel (paid-search): Frequency cap for retarget: 4/day. Cap remarketing bids to keep CPM predictable. Negative keyword sweep applied for low-intent queries: "cheap", "torrent", "crack". Also excluding competitor names for brand-safe bidding.

dee (content): Uploaded assets to Ads > library: `mid_vid_15s_v1.mp4`, `carousel_pain_v2.png`. CTA on all creatives: "Reserve spot" to match landing. No mention of pricing.

marco (growth): We'll run a headline microtest for 36h: Variant A "Ship inference features faster" vs Variant B "Cut per-token cost by 3x". Winner used in primary search ads only.

sam (analytics): I'll add a short live dashboard widget for CPL, SQL rate, creative-level CTR. Alert if CPL > $50 or SQL rate < 8% in 12h window.
tina (ops): Flipping live routing at 08:00 PT tomorrow. Confirmed SFDC mapping in staging. Also enabling slack notifications to #webinar-inbound with `creative_id` and `utm_campaign`.
rachel (paid-search): Scheduling the budget ramp: 0->40% shift at 08:00, then pause and review after 8h. If CTR uplift >10% for creative variant, scale remaining budget by +20%.
dee (content): Small change: shorten headline length for mobile — will push `mid_vid_15s_v2.mp4` with alt subtitle.
marco (growth): Great. Keep updates concise. Post a short recap at +8h and +24h. If SQLs spike, tag @sales-leads for immediate outreach. :rocket:
